t: 塞尔柱人在丹达纳干战役中击败了加兹纳维德人.
te: The Seljuks defeat the Ghaznavids in the battle of Dandanaqan.

dz: 邓肯国王 我死在与他堂兄和对手麦克白的战斗中 后者继承他为苏格兰国王.
de: King Duncan I is killed in battle against his first cousin and rival Macbeth. The latter succeeds him as King of Scotland.
